text: Hey, good morning!  I just downloaded your app, and want to give a brief feedback.  First of all, congratulations to the app, it has a very clean, with a smooth fps and flaw, it's very useful.  Secondly I have some suggestions for further improvements based on my experiences with other alike apps and with yours:   -my greatest concern and deficit of the app is that it doesn't have a grading system. You can't catch up with your notes from some months ago. You have to have a side-app to complete your virtual study book which is not too practical. In order to improve and basically make the app almost perfect would be this. Nonetheless every possible grading system should be included (numeric from 1-10, alphabetic, weighted, etc.)  -when I tried to correct the beginning hour of one of my classes it didn't want to change it in the calendar, so I had to delete the class and re-enter every data. It happened on pc, on Microsoft Edge.   -you could make it possible to removing Saturday and  Sunday from the calendar if one does not have classes then.   -you could include an auto-syncing feature, which would sync the app with other platforms upon every opening.  -an another deficiency for me is the little amount of colors which you can pick for subjects. I know it changes gradually when you have more and more subjects, but you could give us the freedom of choosing..:) Maybe you could put the RGB palette there, I saw that solution in other similar apps too, and it's very helpful.  -when you assign an exam and select the day and subject of it, the app could auto-detect the beginning hour of it and auto-fill that bar, with of course the possibility to change it.  -in the schedule menu you could add a non-alphabetic but custom ordering option  -in the tasks menu the number of remaining days until deadline could be stated too, not just the date  -I know, it would be a lot of re-designing and aligning but I really miss the tablet version of it, this magnified IPhone view on my iPad is not good.  -this is my last pain in the ass: dark mode, I want it! >< So, this is it, my brief review. I hope it will be useful, and you'll catch some ideas ot of it.
